caseName: Moister v. General Motors Acceptance Corp.
caseNameFull: Roger W. MOISTER, Jr., as Chapter Seven Trustee for Alfred D. Busenlehner and Faye Elaine Busenlehner v. GENERAL MOTORS ACCEPTANCE CORPORATION

opinions.text:
The motion of petitioner to defer consideration of the petition for a writ of certiorari is denied. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit denied.

Justice WHITE would grant certiorari.
